description: This file defines the LevelSelectScreen React component, which provides a user interface for selecting a difficulty level in a Tic-Tac-Toe game. It includes header and level selection components, handles navigation to the game screen with selected options, and employs react-router hooks for routing.

methods.name: LevelSelectScreen()
methods.description: React functional component that renders the level selection interface and manages navigation based on user input.

methods.name: handleSelect
methods.description: Callback function invoked when a level is selected; navigates to the game screen passing mode and level as state.
